title: PA1-OPD: One-Step Prefix-Augmented On-Policy Distillation for Language Model Pretraining
abstract: arXiv:2610.19601v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Knowledge distillation (KD) improves language-model pretraining by matching teacher distributions at corpus prefixes, but provides no direct supervision at contexts induced by student predictions. We introduce PA1-OPD, which augments corpus-path distillation with teacher feedback after one student-sampled transition per selected prefix. This expands the supervised states while retaining next-token prediction and corpus-path KD. Data-anchored roots support parallel sampling, and differentiable tree attention shares prefix computation without changing inference. In two continued-pretraining settings, full coverage improves held-out cross-entropy over KD across C4, PG-19, and Pile at every evaluated checkpoint. In Stage2, selecting the 10% of roots with highest student surprisal adds 48.85% to KD's Macro cross-entropy gain over next-token training. translated_title: PA1-OPD：用于语言模型预训练的单步前缀增强在线策略蒸馏
translated_abstract: 知识蒸馏（KD）通过在语料库前缀处匹配教师模型分布来改进语言模型预训练，但对学生预测所诱导的上下文不提供直接监督。我们提出PA1-OPD，它在每个选定前缀处进行一次学生采样的状态转移后，引入教师反馈来增强语料路径蒸馏。这在保留下一词预测和语料路径知识蒸馏的同时，扩展了受监督的状态集合。数据锚定的根节点支持并行采样，可微的树注意力机制共享前缀计算且不改变推理过程。在两个继续预训练设置中，全覆盖率方案在C4、PG-19和Pile数据集上的每个评估检查点都取得了比KD更好的保留交叉熵。在Stage2阶段，选择学生困惑度最高的10%根节点，使KD相对于下一词训练的Macro交叉熵增益额外提升了48.85%。当分支监督排除已在语料路径上的后继状态时，增益依然保持。
tldr: PA1-OPD通过在每个前缀处引入学生采样转移后的教师反馈，扩展了知识蒸馏的监督状态覆盖范围，同时利用数据锚定根节点和可微树注意力实现高效并行训练，在多个数据集的继续预训练中显著优于传统知识蒸馏方法。
